issues.note: Noise is characteristic of sneezing; 'usually loud' would be slightly more exact, not wrong.
Sneeze on is covered by the intransitive sense; worth a collocation, not missing use.
Mentioning a variety or English-speaking world is allowed; culture notes expect this.
Achoo is the usual American spelling; 'usually written' would be more accurate.
House convention: no length marks in General American IPA; sniz is correct.
Usually after be is accurate but confusing since phrase contains be; wording could clarify.
